name: JSON Support
detailedDescription:
## JSON language support

Edit JSON and JSONC configuration files with real-time validation, auto-completion, schema validation, and formatting powered by **vscode-json-languageserver**.

### Features

- Auto-completion for properties and values
- Syntax validation and error diagnostics
- Document formatting and folding ranges
- Support for standard JSON, JSONC (with comments), and JSON5
